verdict.rationale: Mastra is a TypeScript agent framework with a server and cloud deployment, so offering a machine-readable API spec is a fair question for it. However, no evidence shows it publishes one: the OpenAPI probe returned 404 on every candidate path. The llms.txt and docs.md files are LLM-oriented documentation, not an API specification, and MCP server authoring is a different capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
